question: Should this issue remain the broad memory-management consistency tracker while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 and the Memory MVP issues handle slices, or should it be narrowed to one specific config/API contract?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory configuration, plugin ownership, doctor migration, docs, and memory lifecycle semantics; source inspection can prove the gap but cannot choose the durable product contract.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until backend, role-slot, flush, and operator-surface contracts converge through the linked memory work.

options.title: Narrow To Role Slots
options.body: Declare https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 canonical for slot ownership, then narrow this issue to backend and flush semantics.

options.title: Sponsor memory.type Design
options.body: Approve a smaller builtin-only/qmd-only/mixed config design, accepting that role ownership and memory writes still need separate decisions.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until backend, role-slot, flush, and operator-surface contracts converge through the linked memory work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about public OpenClaw memory config, plugin API, and storage direction, which matches the project decision-owner role listed in CONTRIBUTING.md.
